'''Pont Edisser''' was a [[Gender/Legends|fireman]]<ref name="Cross-Sections" /> in [[Fire Team Three/Legends|Fire Team Three]], a division of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Coruscant Rescue Ops/Legends|Coruscant Rescue Ops]],<ref name="DB Firefighters" /> who served aboard an [[Emergency firespeeder/Legends|emergency firespeeder]] captained by [[Jikesh Valia/Legends|Jikesh Valia]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|226|Edisser, Pont}}</ref> during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="Cross-Sections" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}}, which includes the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> During that battle, Edisser approached a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] disk platform to engage in flying rescues while he wore a [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Clothing/Legends|bodysuit]] with black [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Cross-Sections" /> Edisser's [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] aided in the safe landing of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]<ref name="CSWE" /> performed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pont Edisser was first referenced by ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] reference book written by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Cross-Sections" />
